title: Contrastive Mixed Prompt Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combination
abstract: arXiv:2608.20019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis has garnered significant attention in recent years. Existing approaches typically assume that data is missing at random or are designed specifically for certain missing patterns, ignoring the modality combination inconsistency between training and testing phases. However, in real-world scenarios, the testing phase often encounters modal combinations that were not present during the training phase, which leads to insufficient generalization capabilities and unstable performance. In this paper, we introduce the problem of Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Unseen Modality Combinations (IMSAUMC), aiming to enhance model generalization for unseen modality combinations. To address this challenge, we propose the model named $\textbf{C}$ontrastive $\textbf{M}$ixed $\textbf{P}$rompt $\textbf{L}$earning ($\textsf{CMPL}$) for IMSAUMC. translated_title: 面向不可见模态组合的不完整多模态情感分析的对比混合提示学习
translated_abstract: 近年来，不完整多模态情感分析引起了广泛关注。现有方法通常假设数据是随机缺失的，或针对特定缺失模式设计，忽略了训练和测试阶段之间的模态组合不一致性。然而，在现实场景中，测试阶段经常遇到训练阶段未出现的模态组合，这导致泛化能力不足和性能不稳定。本文引入了“具有不可见模态组合的不完整多模态情感分析”（IMSAUMC）问题，旨在增强模型对不可见模态组合的泛化能力。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了名为对比混合提示学习（CMPL）的模型。该模型引入了一种标签引导的对比特征学习机制。
tldr: 本文提出对比混合提示学习（CMPL）模型，通过标签引导的对比特征学习，有效处理训练与测试阶段模态组合不一致的问题，提升对不可见模态组合的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Contrastive Mixed Prompt Learning (CMPL) model that leverages label-guided contrastive feature learning to handle modality combination inconsistency between training and testing, enhancing generalization to unseen modality combinations.
